g.title: j3668723447
g.text: so future... you're from the future right?

g.title: j1425701222
g.text: Without getting over my head on Eternalism, yeah, I'm from the future.

g.title: j1408124711
g.text: tell me about all the aliens

g.title: j2154551132
g.text: Zaznog The Imbiber could drink you under the table.

g.title: j1248018854
g.text: you know, aliens, ufos, friggin probings!

g.title: j3498181921
g.text: whoa! really? what does he drink?

g.title: j2652966055
g.text: I hate to let you down...

g.title: j167887948
g.text: There's the Sentients but I'm pretty sure that's not what you mean.

g.title: j3492406065
g.text: Piston oil, mostly. He loves piston oil.

g.title: j329228497
g.text: the sentients came from earth originally though

g.title: j1890313458
g.text: not even like a message from a far off solar system?

g.title: j4146478788
g.text: i'm talking like in planet spacers

g.title: j684139943
g.text: wait? are you messing with me?

g.title: j1643135117
g.text: funny looking aliens that fly around the galaxy at light speed making friends and fight bad guys

g.title: j81602320
g.text: so many years in the future, there has to be something

g.title: j1733183056
g.text: or i don't know, that's why i'm asking

g.title: j1042423222
g.text: If there was, nobody ever told me.

g.title: j1758275929
g.text: If the Orokin discovered aliens, they kept it to themselves.

g.title: j365551459
g.text: there must be aliens, tell me about them, i have to know
